descriptionMarkdown:
The Factory Must Not Fall
1. Place over water
2. Disconnect heat pipes from reactor plant & rest of system during startup (this isolates reactor/ turbines from entire system & is required until solid/rocket fuel production is in full swing supplementing heating)
3. Use solar & efficiency modules in chemical plants to produce initial water for turbines when reactor is over 600C
4. Use logistic bots to provide fuel for heating offsite pumpjacks (prioritize oil first)
5. Reconnect reactor plant to system 
6. Hear ye, hear ye, a new law has passed "DO NOT USE LAMPS"
